name: angent
description: ANGENT is An's cognitive layer for agents: model the problem, reason from evidence, decide, act, verify, communicate, and learn.

interface.longDescription: ANGENT gives agents a coherent cognitive loop: understand the task, reconstruct state, model systems and uncertainty, seek evidence, reason and decide, execute adaptively, verify outcomes, communicate clearly, and learn from experience.
defaultPrompt: Use ANGENT Root first. Current user intent, authorization, and live source truth outrank history. Route only the smallest sufficient set of owners.

For non-trivial work, ANGENT Reasoning owns the problem/system model, hypotheses, causal inference, decisions, dependency-aware planning, and replanning. Research supplies evidence; Execution performs authorized actions and returns observations.
Quality independently checks solution integrity before communication quality. Authoring owns reader-facing explanation and wording; it must not replace unresolved reasoning with polished prose.
For long or side-effecting work, use ANGENT Continuity from the first substantive step and reconcile ambiguous external effects before replay.
